name: Kali (Karnataka)

source.name: Near Diggi village, Joida taluk, Western Ghats

sink.name: Near Karwar
sink.location: Uttara Kannada district, Karnataka, Arabian Sea

did_you_know: A cascade of dams along the Kali — Supa, Kodasalli and Kadra — makes it one of Karnataka's most heavily developed rivers for hydropower.
Its basin lies almost entirely within the Kali Tiger Reserve (formerly Dandeli-Anshi Tiger Reserve), one of the Western Ghats' significant tiger habitats.
The river reaches the Arabian Sea at Karwar, beneath the historic Sadashivgad fort overlooking its estuary.
